How a clownfish swims

the biomechanics behind the aquarium level’s fish rig · Amphiprion ocellaris · numbers, formulas and how far to trust each one
The level is ×10 in space and real in time: speeds are in body lengths per second, frequencies in hertz. The fish is 3.5 in (8.9 cm) real, 0.889 m in the level; cruise 3.048 m/s (3.43 BL/s).
A · Body wave: amplitude grows from head to tail; wavelength ≈ one body length
B · Tail-beat frequency follows speed (Strouhal number)
C · Burst-and-coast: the gait the game gives the fish
D · Pectoral fins: beat rate and gait
E · Turning: the head leads, the body bends
F · Facing, velocity along the nose, and the control chain
G · Damped steering: why ζ decides how a turn feels
H · Parameter table: every number, its unit, its source and how far to trust it

How to read the chips

verified opened; the number is on the page

“ours” values come from the game’s code at build time. Not used: Rohr & Fish 2004 (cetaceans). Data dated 2026‑09‑30.
